quest.title: Those Hard-to-Reach Places
quest.description: Knight of Favonius Aramis is worried about the flower petals blowing all over the place...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Hero's Wit x2, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Oh, what am I to do...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you need help with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Whenever the Windblume Festival rolls along, people will always offer up all manner of flowers to the Archon statue. Then a gust of wind comes, and off they go, flying every which way.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: We've had to spend no small amount of effort to clear these withered flowers out. But while I can handle the flowers and leaves in the plaza itself, there's not much I can do about the ones that get onto roofs and the city walls.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: Definitely not with these knees of mine. They really aren't holding up well...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll lend you a hand.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: You would? Oh, that's wonderful. Those withered flowers are pretty obvious. You should be able to see them the moment you get on top of a roof.

talks.objective: Clear the piles of floral debris off the rooftop

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, there really are heaps of withered flowers. Quickly, let's clear these piles out.

talks.objective: Clear the piles of floral debris off the rooftop

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's that sound? Sounds like a cat...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, where is it... Let's keep an eye out while we're cleaning up.

talks.objective: Clear the piles of floral debris off the city walls

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, guess there really was a cat. Wonder why it's over here...

dialogues.speaker: Lost Cat
dialogues.text: Meow... Meeeow...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, hate to break it to you, but Paimon doesn't think it understands a thing you just said...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's get it down from here first. Maybe Aramis knows who it belongs to.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I don't think I've seen it. If I did, I'm sure I would have had some impression.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Oh, I see... That little darling really loves flowers. I thought that she might have chased them here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Someone looking for a cat?

dialogues.speaker: Lost Cat
dialogues.text: Meow... Meow!

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Is that... Butterfly? Oh, it really is you! Where have you been?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: On the city walls.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: So it's just as I thought, then... Thank you so much. Butterfly here loves to chase flowers. She's been a real headache during this time, what with there being flowers all over the city and all.

dialogues.speaker: Margaret
dialogues.text: Thank you once again — your next drink's on me the next time you visit The Cat's Tail. Well, the non-alcoholic ones, at least.

response.speaker: Margaret
response.text: Haha... Once again, thank you. See you around, and happy Windblume Festival.

response.speaker: Aramis
response.text: Well, I never — so cats are attracted to the flowers too. What a busy festival... Still, it's good that you found that cat.

response.speaker: Aramis
response.text: If you'd asked me to climb up there to rescue it, I'm afraid my knees would have given up the ghost...

response.speaker: Aramis
response.text: Well then, thank you for your trouble. Here's a little something for your work.

choices.text: Let's save that tab for next time, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Aramis
dialogues.text: *sigh* More steps here, and a couple of roofs there, up and down, up and down... I don't know how long my knees will last at this rate...
